quest.title: Reliable Helper
quest.description: The Snezhnayan merchant Tsarevich is looking for a dependable person to help him resolve a few problems.
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x1000, Mora x5000, Mora x1000, Mora x5000, Mora x1000, Mora x5000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take the foot of the mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: The foot, is it? There's not much down there, just a bunch of hilichurls. They're not much of a threat, but they are an eyesore.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Go and take care of them all. For such a simple task, I'll give you... one minute. That should be enough.

talks.objective: Defeat the Hilichurls as requested by Tsarevich

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Done and dusted.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: So soon? In less than a minute, even! You're quite good. Quite good indeed, hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Good, good. 5,000 Mora, and not one Mora less. Take it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Quite good," and all we get is 5,000 Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Don't you get picky, now. I calculated this remuneration very carefully, and it is commensurate with the work.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: One must do great things to earn great rewards. If we have the chance to meet again, you can try your luck then.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I, the Wicked Capitalist

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a wrap.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Dragging your feet, just like the Knights of Favonius. I gave you a minute! Did you forget, or did you not listen in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: No attention paid, even to such simple details... 1,000 Mora it is. Do with it what you will.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: 1,000 Mora? So little!?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: How much do you expect for a job done like that? This is the pay you deserve — now take it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's done.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Did you mishear me, or are you hoping that I'll let this slide? Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: I told you not to break those boxes, and you broke this many? Can they even be sold at this point?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't see any goods...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: It was those boxes! Those were my goods! Why do you think I would stack them up outside anyway otherwise?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Forget it. Forget it! I have nothing to say to attention-deficient louts like you. Here's 1,000 Mora — take it and be off!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: 1,000 Mora? That's way too little!

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Too little? You can't even do a simple job right, and you want more money? This is the amount you deserve!

talks.objective: Defeat the Hilichurls as requested by Tsarevich
Defeat the Hilichurls as requested by Tsarevich

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll head for the mountainside.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Ah, there's some cargo of mine that I had intended to transport back and sell on the mountainside.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: But now, not only have the roads been blocked, but the area where I stored my cargo has also been occupied by hilichurls.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Fortunately, they don't have a good eye for value, and didn't touch my goods.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Now go and clear them out, and remember not to touch my cargo. Those boxes break easily.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: *sigh* With these roads being blocked, those goods probably can't be sold anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll go for the mountaintop.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: The group of hilichurls on the mountaintop are the hardest to deal with. I used to go there to relax, but now I dare not even venture close. Very unfortunate.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Well, you look quite capable, so I suppose it'll be a fitting task for you.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Remember, that big blockhead with the axe has to go first. Watching him walk around all full of himself just makes my blood boil.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Then there's the one that waves its big shield around in your face. What an eyesore...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Finally, you want to take out those with the long staves... What do they call them, again? Samachurls? Either way, they don't look so tough...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: In any case, get rid of them all. Get them out of my sight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Not bad, not bad. Not a box was damaged, either — you know what you're doing.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Here, take this 5,000 Mora. If the opportunity comes, let us do business again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All that work, just for 5,000 Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Don't you get picky, now. I calculated this remuneration very carefully, and it is commensurate with the work.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: One must do great things to earn great rewards. If we have the chance to meet again, you can try your luck then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a wrap.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Not... Not bad at all, you...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Forget it, I'll say nothing more. Take this 5,000 Mora. We Snezhnayan merchants always deliver as promised.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Snezhnayan merchants only deliver 5,000 Mora, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Don't you get picky, now. I calculated this remuneration very carefully, and it is commensurate with the work.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: One must do great things to earn great rewards. If we have the chance to meet again, you can try your luck then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's done.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: ...I watched you work from the side, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: But are you just used to doing things at your own pace, or did you not pay any heed to the order I gave you at all?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Do you know? In Snezhnaya, we say that we "deliver as promised."

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: I pay you to do things for me, and every word that I say has meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: You did complete the task, but these results... I can only give you 1,000 Mora at most. Take it and go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? 1,000 Mora? What can we even use that for?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Hmph. Too little, you say? You didn't even do the job right. This 1,000 Mora is more than sufficient.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: So. Have you done as I asked?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: What awful luck. These Knights of Favonius are really...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Hmph! These Knights of Favonius have no sense of efficiency at all. They said that there were monsters ahead, and wouldn't let me pass.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: But even now, I still haven't received anything more concrete from them. What an unreliable lot...

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: I still have so many matters to attend to. Do they have any idea how much money they're costing me?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Still... Well, you look like an adventurer, don't you? How about this — would you be willing to do a little something for me? I'll pay you.

response.speaker: Tsarevich
response.text: Wonderful. I love straightforward people. You will be well rewarded once the deed is done, I guarantee it.

response.speaker: Tsarevich
response.text: Perhaps my eyes deceive me, but the hilichurls around Mondstadt seem to have grown more numerous. Who knows what these so-called Knights are doing all day?

response.speaker: Tsarevich
response.text: Since you've agreed to aid me, then you can help to drive them off for me. Yet, you are only one person. Hmm...

response.speaker: Tsarevich
response.text: Forget it. Pick one of these areas to clean out yourself: the peak, side or foot of the mountain.

response.speaker: Tsarevich
response.text: It's all hilichurls no matter where you go, so there's no difference. Now go, and don't waste my time.

response.speaker: Tsarevich
response.text: Hah, that will depend on the manner of your deeds. If you do well, I will see to it that you are well rewarded.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Why are you still here? Get over there! It's just a bunch of hilichurls, how long do you plan to dilly-dally?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: So. Have you done as I asked?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Don't touch those boxes however you like. If they break, I can't sell them.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: They aren't worth a lot, but I still bought them with Mora — they didn't just drop from the sky into my lap.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: What misfortune. The road is impassable, my goods can't be moved, and I can't even take a good walk.

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: What in the world do the Knights do with their time, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Tsarevich
dialogues.text: Hmph. If this was Snezhnaya...
